newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to give provinces C$2 bln for jobs program.
newsitem.headline: Canada to give provinces C$2 bln for jobs program.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Wednesday the federal government would give about C$2.0 billion to the provinces and territories for employment program reform measures.

"Approximately C$2.0 billion will be made available in discussions with provinces and territories for results-oriented employment measures," Martin said in his autumn economic and fiscal update, which he delivered in parliament.

Such measures, he said, could include targeted wages subsidies, targeted earnings supplements, self-employment assistance, job creation partnerships between the provinces, the private sector and communities, and skill loans and grants.
